reviewScope.excluded: All profile-local readme directives (including Bookings/v1.0/readme.md and Bookings/beta/readme.md) and src/readme.graph.md are explicitly ignored.
reviewScope.deferred: Parameter aliases/transforms and schema/response directives remain deferred; none occur in the three shared groups.
reviewScope.naming: Retain the existing Solution-prefix strip and BackupRestore exception; do not add redundant overrides. The baseline generator uses Mg for both profiles; beta prefix-only parity differences are outside this migration.

mappings.notes: The original selector matches GET/PATCH /solutions in both legacy AutoRest specs. Explicitly bridge each exact legacy method/path/operation-ID to the compatible operation rather than treating the singular-to-plural ID conversion as API absence. Existing exact-path suppression already implements both translated root operations.

v1.0.notes: Legacy root operation IDs solution.solutionsRoot_GetSolutionsRoot and solution.solutionsRoot_UpdateSolutionsRoot translate to compatible plural/dotted IDs on the same exact GET/PATCH /solutions routes.

beta.notes: Legacy root operation IDs solution.solutionsRoot_GetSolutionsRoot and solution.solutionsRoot_UpdateSolutionsRoot translate to compatible plural/dotted IDs on the same exact GET/PATCH /solutions routes.

mappings.notes: Existing exact /solutions/virtualEvents suppression covers GET, PATCH (including expanded parameter forms), and DELETE in both profiles. Do not suppress child events, webinars, townhalls, or unrelated booking operations.

Existing StripNounPrefix already removes Solution from every /solutions/ child noun. Enumerate the full reviewed method/path/operation-ID set, including suppressed virtualEvents root operations. BackupRestore is absent from these specs; preserve and independently pin its existing exception rather than extending this rename. Beta top-level /bookingBusinesses and /bookingCurrencies routes are outside this selector and remain unchanged.

routeSelectionPolicy.scope: Separately authorized additive route selection, not migration of ignored profile-local directives. Preserve both URLs and use the published route as the per-pair default.
routeSelectionPolicy.notes: Fifty pairs default to legacy top-level paths. Appointment cancel, calendarView cancel, and getStaffAvailability default to solutions paths. Published command names are evidence only; this policy does not override the baseline Mg beta prefix or action verbs.
